summary: Iter-27 sprint (attendance certs + cross-tenant marketplace + collapsible funnel + LiveSessionsPage refactor + streak-nudge worker) fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 30/30 pytest across test_iteration27_sprint.py (7/7) + test_iteration26_sprint.py (10/10) + test_iteration20_retest.py (13/13). Frontend + integration: (1) Attendance-cert lifecycle end-to-end through the ingress — create session → learner RSVPs → admin marks ATTENDED via manage-{sid} button → attendance-modal renders → mark-attend-{lid} click fires POST /api/live-sessions/{id}/mark-attendance returning attendance_certs_issued=1 → sonner toast 'Attendance recorded · certificate issued' appears → GET /api/certificates includes LIVE_SESSION_ATTENDANCE row → /pdf returns %PDF- (5048 bytes) → verify/{code} returns valid=True, type=LIVE_SESSION_ATTENDANCE, course_title=session_title → second mark returns attendance_certs_issued=0 (idempotent). (2) CATALOG — catalog-org-filter dropdown renders with 64 options (All publishers + 63 opted-in orgs); IFPI Main Academy (3) is first (sorted by course_count desc); typing 'IFPI' in search surfaces 3 IFPI-Main-Academy courses (including two TEST_iter26sprint_* whose titles don't contain 'IFPI') — proves cross-tenant org-name search works. (3) COURSE FUNNEL — /courses/1/edit renders toggle-funnel-trend + toggle-slide-dropoff. Fresh localStorage → both sections expanded. Click each toggle → sections collapse, localStorage keys funnel-show-trend='0' + funnel-show-dropoff='0' persist. Reload → sections stay collapsed. Re-click → re-expand. (4) LIVE SESSIONS REFACTOR — Admin sees Schedule button (opens create-session-modal, all inputs data-testid'd via extracted CreateSessionModal.tsx), can open Attendance modal on any session (AttendanceModal.tsx renders attendance-list + mark-attend-* + mark-noshow-*), Learner clicking subscribe-calendar-btn opens subscription-kind-picker with both pick-kind-learner + pick-kind-my-rsvps options (extracted SubscriptionModal.tsx). Zero visual regressions. (5) STREAK-NUDGE — worker in-process test seeds 3-day streak minus today, first run emits STREAK_NUDGE notification (notified>=1), second run within cooldown returns notified=0 + skipped_cooldown>=1, users.streak_nudge_last_sent_at is populated.

issues: Cosmetic: many TEST_iter27_attend_* + TEST_iter27_uimodal_* + TEST_iter26sprint_* leftover seed sessions remain in the DB from prior pytest runs — they clutter the list on both admin and learner /live-sessions and /catalog. Non-blocking, but a scheduled cleanup script for TEST_* rows in live_sessions + courses would keep the UI tidy for demos. Suggest adding a fixture teardown or nightly cleanup job.

critical_code_review_comments: ATTENDANCE-CERT PIPELINE (routers/live_sessions.py::_issue_attendance_cert ~line 398) — correctly gated on transition to ATTENDED and pre-existing (session_id, user_id) row check; returns attendance_certs_issued=0 on idempotent re-mark. PDF is generated on-demand via /api/certificates/{id}/pdf (misc.py::download_certificate_pdf) — returns %PDF- with application/pdf content-type. verify/{code} correctly surfaces LIVE_SESSION_ATTENDANCE type + session title as course_title. All 5 sub-checks in the review request pass.

CATALOG_ORGANIZATIONS (routers/misc.py::catalog_organizations) — returns {id, name, logo_url, course_count} sorted by course_count desc. Verified 64 orgs returned; IFPI Main Academy tops with 3 courses. Cross-tenant search matches org name via LIKE join — verified typing 'IFPI' returns IFPI-Main-Academy courses whose titles don't include 'IFPI'.

COURSEFUNNELPANEL COLLAPSE (CourseFunnelPanel.tsx line 136 + 163) — toggle buttons persist state via localStorage keys 'funnel-show-trend' and 'funnel-show-dropoff' (values '0'/'1'). Reload preserves collapsed state. Semantic guards (showTrend, showDropoff) correctly hide funnel-sparkline and slide-dropoff-list. Note: 'baseline: N viewers' label only renders when expanded — good density.

LIVESESSIONSPAGE REFACTOR — successfully split from 667 → 317 lines. Extracted modals (CreateSessionModal, SubscriptionModal + SubscriptionKindPicker, AttendanceModal) preserve every data-testid required by prior iter-22..26 tests. AttendanceModal now includes iter-27 differentiated toast ('Attendance recorded · certificate issued' on ATTENDED, 'Attendance updated' on NO_SHOW). All prior tests remain green.

STREAK-NUDGE WORKER (services/streak_nudge_worker.py) — Notification.type='STREAK_NUDGE' + link_url='/courses' + title 'Keep your streak alive!'. Cooldown enforced via users.streak_nudge_last_sent_at (per-user). Idempotent within cooldown. outbox_worker scheduler now runs run_streak_nudge_pass every 6h — verified via test.

PRE-EXISTING DB CLUTTER — /app/ifpi_lms.db is a stale DB missing totp_secret_enc + streak_nudge_last_sent_at columns; only /app/backend/ifpi_lms.db is the live DB. Tests fail when run from /app cwd but pass from /app/backend cwd. Documented in context — recommend adding pytest.ini or conftest chdir to /app/backend to prevent future confusion.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 iter-27 feature areas verified end-to-end with correct data-testids, network calls, and toasts)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest suite auto-cleans TEST_iter27_attend_* sessions via fixture teardown. UI validation created TEST_iter27_uimodal_* and TEST_iter27_ui_* sessions — cleanup was successful (DELETE returned 200). Some leftover TEST_iter26sprint_* + TEST_iter27_attend_* from prior runs remain in DB (cosmetic clutter in /live-sessions + /catalog; not blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-27 sprint fully certified end-to-end. Backend + frontend both green. When running pytest against local sqlite, ALWAYS cd to /app/backend first — there is a stale /app/ifpi_lms.db missing recent migrations that pytest picks up if invoked from /app. Attendance certificate flow uses the manage-{sid} testid on LiveSessionsPage.tsx (not open-attendance-{sid}). Live-sessions attendance-modal renders learners who RSVPed with the exact server timestamp, mark-attend-{lid} button issues a certificate that shows up in the learner's GET /api/certificates. Backend token is retrieved via 'X-Return-Token: true' header (AUTH_COOKIE_MODE=on). Course 1 currently has baseline_viewers=0 in slide dropoff (slide-view data got cleared since iter-26), so slide-dropoff-list renders as slide-dropoff-empty until a learner walks slides again. localStorage keys for funnel collapse are 'funnel-show-trend' and 'funnel-show-dropoff' (value '0'=collapsed, '1'=expanded).
